title: Wendell and the Veil
author: Rafael Joubert
blurb: Mirabel Quintana, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
